description: Two rectangular-wave oscillators, each with its own pitch, pulse width and volt-per-octave input

params.text: Sets the pitch of oscillator A, four octaves either side of C4
Sets the share of each cycle oscillator A spends at 5V, 1% to 99%
Sets the pitch of oscillator B, four octaves either side of C4
Sets the share of each cycle oscillator B spends at 5V, 1% to 99%

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of oscillator A by one octave per volt, added to its frequency knob with no clamp
Shifts the pulse width of oscillator A by 10% per volt, added to its width knob and clamped between 1% and 99%
Raises the pitch of oscillator B by one octave per volt, added to its frequency knob with no clamp
Shifts the pulse width of oscillator B by 10% per volt, added to its width knob and clamped between 1% and 99%

outputs.text: The rectangular wave from oscillator A, switching between -5V and 5V
The rectangular wave from oscillator B, switching between -5V and 5V

notes: the two oscillators share nothing: no sync, no through-zero, and no common pitch control
nothing on the panel is lettered; the artwork carries the module name and no control labels at all
